outreach.to: Personal-finance blogger jisne haal me is topic pe post likhi ho
outreach.subject: A free credit card payoff tool for your readers
outreach.body:
Hi [Name],

I enjoyed your post "[their post title]" — especially [one specific point].

I run HomeMoney Calc, a free, no-sign-up set of US money calculators. Our credit card payoff calculator might be a useful extra for that post: https://homemoneycalc.com/credit-card-payoff-calculator/ (example: $6,000 at 22.9%, paying $250 → Paid off in 2 yr 9 mo).

If it helps your readers, you're welcome to link it or embed it (free embed code is at the bottom of the page). No pressure at all if it's not a fit.

Thanks,
[Your name]
Founder, HomeMoney Calc

ai.headline: HomeMoney Calc Growth Report: 403 Errors Detected and Connections Pending
ai.summary: Live checks return 403 HTTP status errors on key pages like / and /paycheck-calculator/, blocking users and search engines. Additionally, Google Search Console and GA4 are not yet connected for this agent, and AdSense approval requires verifying traffic data first.
youDo: Connect Search Console API in Google Cloud to give this agent data access.
Set up GA4 traffic tracking so visitor numbers and analytics can be read.
Review server routing and deployment settings to resolve the 403 HTTP errors.
agentNext: Verify live routing fixes once the 403 server block is removed.
Monitor incoming search queries and performance once GSC data access is active.
Check upcoming tool launches and seasonal optimization tasks.
risks: HTTP 403 errors prevent users and search engines from accessing your site, hurting rankings.
Lack of GA4 and GSC data prevents accurate tracking of user growth and AdSense readiness.
Applying for AdSense prematurely without verified traffic data can lead to account delays.
